title: AlphaDefect Advisor
description:
Get advice in English or Japanese for solo Ironclad runs in Slay the Spire 2. The in-game panel recommends a move and shows the model's selection probabilities for up to three actions. You control every play. Drag the panel by its header to move it.

The advisor covers combat, map routes, events, rest sites, shops and rewards. It can recommend cards to pick or upgrade. When your potion belt is full, it can suggest which bottle to discard by name and slot, whether to drink one, or whether to leave the reward.

Compatibility: Windows x64, Steam public-beta v0.114.0. Subscribe, wait for the download, and launch the game from Steam. The mod sets up its own inference runtime and model. Keep an internet connection for the first launch so it can download and verify its data tables. The panel follows the in-game language and uses English for other languages. Item names follow the game.
changeNote: v0.2.8 adds English and Japanese overlay text. The panel follows the game language, including when displaying a pending recommendation.
